nodes.label: Per-Category Retention Policy
nodes.rationale: Defaults come from loopguard_api.retention.DEFAULT_RETENTION_DAYS (events 30 days hosted, verification 90, actions/audit 365, tombstones 2,555); retention changes are versioned and audited and never shorten a legal minimum without privacy/legal approval, and legal hold is explicit per record without granting support access.

nodes.label: HMAC Deletion Tombstone
nodes.rationale: Deletion checkpoints PostgreSQL, object storage/replicas, Temporal search attributes, notification tokens, and derived metrics separately, is idempotent, and resumes without repeating completed destructive stages; completion writes only an HMAC tenant reference, workflow ID, completion time, and stage count.

nodes.label: Tenant-Scoped Export Workflow
nodes.rationale: Export is deterministic-manifested and excludes access/refresh tokens, private keys, credentials, authorization headers, and presigned URLs; the caller encrypts the bundle, and export URLs are short-lived and audience-bound.
